The verb describes circular or spiral movement—rolling something up, winding it around, or turning it. Both active and middle voices appear, with the middle often suggesting the subject revolving itself or turning around. The passive indicates being twisted, coiled, or turned by another agent. Medical uses describe joints or body parts undergoing twisting or rotating movements. The word captures rotational and spiral motion in various contexts."
